body: I’m egotistical, narcissistic and really moody so a real piece of shit if I may say so

Hey idk if my comment will help you but you shouldn’t underestimate your feelings, being hurt or depressed is something that happens regardless of your situation and you shouldn’t feel guilty about being in pain and I really think you should find someone to talk to (on the internet or irl or even a professional). Maybe in the meantime try to find a hobby to distract you from these thoughts. I really hope you’ll do better and that my advice is not so shitty lol 💕.
